learning_outcomes.text: Students have a broad understanding of cybersecurity issues.
They know the vulnerabilities of different communication protocols.
They can describe attack methods on networks, systems and applications and explain the different effects of corresponding attacks.
Students have understood why companies can only protect themselves to a limited extent against cyber attacks.
They can assess to what extent attacks can be prevented by preventive measures and how reactive measures can be set up and operated.
Students understand how cyber attacks occur and can be detected.
Students can examine systems for vulnerabilities and analyze attacks.
Students master the use of appropriate network security tools.

syllabus_topics: Tasks of Cybersecurity Analysts in the company
Security-specific operating system fundamentals: Windows and Linux
Network protocols, services and their vulnerabilities
Logging and log analysis of systems and standard applications
Security Monitoring and Intrusion Detection Tools
Security Incident and Event Management (SIEM) in companies

assessment_methods.method: Presentation with written elaboration (Referat mit schriftlicher Ausarbeitung)

assessment_rules: The lecturer chooses the type of graded examination. For the written examination (Klausur), refer to the applicable study regulations. For the oral examination, refer to the general part of the examination regulations. A presentation should be approx. 20 minutes with an accompanying elaboration of approx. 5-10 pages. The unassessed experimental work consists of approx. 12 experiments in total.
